title: A Wave of Syrup Hit Boston 🍯 #shorts
hook: A wave of syrup hit a city.

lines.say: In 1919, a giant wave flooded the streets of Boston. But it wasn't water. It was molasses.
shots: a huge brown wave of thick syrup rushing down a 1910s city street, toy-like buildings
close-up of thick glossy molasses flowing over cobblestones

lines.say: A huge steel tank held more than eight million litres of sticky syrup.
shots: an enormous round steel tank next to brick buildings by a harbour
a tiny worker looking up at the giant tank

lines.say: On the 15th of January, the tank burst open.
shots: the steel tank splitting open with rivets flying out
dramatic explosion of brown syrup from the tank

lines.say: A wave of molasses, several metres high, rushed through the streets, faster than a person could run.
shots: a tall brown wave sweeping past houses and a train track
people running away from a brown wave, horses and carts

lines.say: It knocked buildings off their foundations, and bent the steel of an elevated railway.
shots: an elevated train track bent by the syrup wave
a wooden building collapsed into thick brown syrup

lines.say: Sadly, twenty one people died, and around one hundred and fifty were hurt.
shots: rescuers in thick syrup up to their knees, sombre mood
a quiet harbour at dusk, sticky streets

lines.say: Cleaning it up took weeks. The harbour stayed brown for months.
shots: workers spraying the street with water hoses, brown runoff
the harbour water tinted brown, seagulls flying

lines.say: Some locals said the area smelled sweet for years. Had you ever heard of this one?
shots: a quiet Boston street in sunshine years later, a small plaque on a wall
a jar of molasses on a windowsill with the city behind

description:
On 15 January 1919 a tank holding about 8.7 million litres of molasses burst in Boston's North End, sending a wave through the streets that killed 21 people. A true story: the Great Molasses Flood.

Sources: Massachusetts Historical Society; Wikipedia: Great Molasses Flood.

Made with AI-assisted pictures and voice.
